headlines.title: DA did not review statements and other evidence collected in alleged rape of Cornell student
headlines.description: Cornell University police spoke to witnesses and received tips about an alleged gang rape at a frat house, but the district attorney did not review the information before deciding not to bring charges.

headlines.title: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul says Jane Doe in Cornell case was ‘failed’ by the system
headlines.description: Hochul tapped New York Attorney General Letitia James to take over the case on Thursday, as questions swirl over how local officials handled the matter.

headlines.title: 'Less than 1%' of bills introduced in this Congress have been enacted into law
headlines.description: NBC News senior national political reporter Sahil Kapur joins Meet the Press NOW to explain how effective Congress has been since President Trump returned to the White House.

headlines.title: Democrats regain ground on voter registration in key states after steep post-2024 drops
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk analysis of voter file data in seven states found that Democrats managed to reverse or slow their registration decline over the past year.

headlines.title: Christa Pike unconscious and on a ventilator after failed execution
headlines.description: Lawyers for Christa Pike say she is critically ill, intubated, and on a ventilator at a hospital in Tennessee. She survived two lethal doses during the attempted execution for a murder she committed when she was 18. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports.

headlines.title: Co-pilot attacker had been banned from flying over his radical views
headlines.description: The Wall Street Journal reports the co-pilot who tried to fly a plane bound for Israel into the ground had been banned from flying by his home country, Oman, over his radical views. Plus, an Israeli official told NBC News investigators discovered the co-pilot had posted on social media that he wanted to kill Jews. NBC News’ Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: How 16 undecided voters are weighing their 2026 election options
headlines.description: The voters, who participated in a recent NBC News poll and spoke to reporters afterward, are laser-focused on high prices and largely disappointed with both parties.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Hawaii’s picturesque Hōlei Sea Arch collapses into the ocean
headlines.description: The Google Maps red pin for the Hōlei Sea Arch, a rugged, 90-foot bow formed by 550-year-old lava flows and the prolonged sculpture of the salty Pacific, now states, “Permanently closed.”

headlines.title: The shifting Senate map: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Two Iranian nationals charged over alleged terrorism plot targeting Jewish community in England
headlines.description: British police said Friday that they had charged two Iranian nationals accused of plotting a terrorist attack against the Jewish community in Manchester on the eve of Yom Kippur, the holiest day in the Jewish calendar.
